---
title: "About"
---

## What this is

An informal group of academics, at every career stage, comparing notes on how AI actually
lands in teaching and research. We started by meeting and talking. This site is the part
of those conversations that turned out to be worth writing down.

## What belongs here

Workflows you actually use. A prompt that reliably does something tedious, a script that
wraps a model, a grading process, a literature pipeline, a failure worth warning others
about. Concrete beats comprehensive.

What does not belong: speculation about where AI is going, position pieces, or tool
announcements from people who have not used the tool.

## Where this is going

If enough people contribute, and enough others find it useful, a small workshop. That is
the ambition, and it depends entirely on whether the content is good.

## Contributing

Anyone in the group can add a project, and the site is open source so anyone can read the
source, fork it, or reuse the scaffolding. Contributions are reviewed before they go live,
since everything here appears under a named author. See [Contribute](contribute.qmd).
